entities.name: Query protein (552 aa)
observations: Sequence is 552 amino acids; estimated molecular mass 60.37 kDa and theoretical pI 5.67.
Closest reviewed references are pyrophosphate-dependent phosphofructokinases, with 55.9–64.2% identity and 99.3–99.8% query coverage.
Sequence matches Pfam PFK domain PF00365.26 at residues 73–329.

Function is inferred by strong homology: PPi-dependent conversion of fructose 6-phosphate to fructose 1,6-bisphosphate; Mg2+ requirement and cytoplasmic localization are reference annotations, not direct assay results.

entities.name: Pyrophosphate-dependent PFK
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations identify EC 2.7.1.90 and reaction beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + diphosphate = beta-D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate + phosphate + H+ (Rhea:13613).
Homolog annotations report Mg2+ as cofactor, cytoplasmic localization, and homodimeric assembly. These properties are inferred for the query, not experimentally established.
